meta.title: fix: improve E2E test performance by avoiding unnecessary redirects
meta.body_summary: Introduce DEFAULT_TEST_URL pointing directly to Mastodon schema ERD page, replacing '/' navigation in E2E tests to eliminate 300-600ms redirect delays and improve test suite performance.

perf_labels.notes: Devin introduced DEFAULT_TEST_URL to avoid redirects; merged after code organization feedback and bot-assisted refactoring with narrative CI evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 64 changed lines across 8 files, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, low-risk performance improvement PR and was merged successfully after addressing code organization feedback.

review_details.concern_detail: hoshinotsuyoshi suggested moving the DEFAULT_TEST_URL constant from playwright.config.ts to a dedicated default_test_url.ts file; claude bot implemented the refactoring.
review_details.performance_claim: Eliminate 300-600ms redirect delay per test by directly navigating to the Mastodon schema ERD page.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple configuration optimization in test files; no deep technical stack barrier. Merge relied on human review for code organization nitpicks.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes screenshot of reduced redirects and CI run links, but no rigorous benchmark or before/after timing comparison beyond narrative claims.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions observed; only style/refactoring fixes applied before merge.

core_change_summary.description: Added DEFAULT_TEST_URL constant initially in playwright.config.ts, then extracted to dedicated default_test_url.ts after review. Updated all E2E test files and global-setup.ts to use the new constant, avoiding redirects from '/' to the schema page.
